findings.message: Assessment blueprint violation: the approved blueprint (specs/content/efmp-301/content-spec.md:409-415) promises MCQ spread 3/3/2/2 and RRQ spread 2/3/2/3 across topics 2.1-2.4, but the delivered bank maps MCQ 5/2/2/1 (T2.1 MCQ-01..05, T2.2 06-07, T2.3 08-09, T2.4 10) and RRQ 4/1/3/2 (T2.1 RRQ-01,02,03,05, T2.2 04, T2.3 06,07,10, T2.4 08,09) per specs/content/efmp-301/concepts/unit-02.md:15-27; the ERQ spread 1/1/1/2 matches. Sub-topic U2-5 (puberty and adolescence) has no dedicated assessment item (CON:EFMP-301-2-7 carries "-"). Repair: re-topic at least two MCQs and two RRQs toward Topics 2.2 and 2.4 and add a direct U2-5 item, or record an owner amendment to the blueprint.

Sources declaration overstates the binding: specs/content/efmp-301/sources/unit-02.md:6-8 states the guide two recommended books "are both open access and both are bound here" and that the unit teaching prose rests on them, but the file own tables bind only seifert2009 (guide book 2); seifert-hk (guide book 1, a mapped reading for this unit at content-spec.md:316) is neither bound nor cited anywhere in the unit. Repair: bind a seifert-hk Chapter 3 excerpt as the second view, or correct the declaration to state exactly what was consulted and why the second view was not needed.

Guide misattribution: docs/semester-1/efmp-301/unit-02/unit-teacher-notes.mdx:85-87 presents the pupil-observation task as "The guide practical component for this chapter", and specs/content/efmp-301/sources/unit-02.md:21 calls it "guide-named practical work". The guide Practical Work list (Scheme-and-Course-guides/extracted-text/1st 2026.txt, EFMP-301 block) is course-generic (hands-on computer exercises, individual assignments, group assignments, presentations, internet-research tasks) and names no chapter-specific task; docs/semester-1/efmp-301/course-overview.mdx:79-83 frames the relationship correctly ("Each unit teacher notes carry the unit practical task"). Repair: reword both passages to present the task as the unit own practical work aligned with the guide generic components.

Sub-pixel at display size, but a committed geometry violation. Repair: shorten the cell text or reduce/shift the column, then regenerate the dark variant.

Bare-URL link text in the four Further Reading blocks (topic-01.mdx:222-227, topic-02.mdx:190-193, topic-03.mdx:210-215, topic-04.mdx:208-211): the open.umn.edu and eric.ed.gov URLs serve as the link text. Link purpose is recoverable from the surrounding citation context, so advisory only.

Number drift in paraphrase: topic-02.mdx:52-54 says individual healthy six-year-olds "range roughly ten centimetres either side" of the 115 cm average; the bound excerpt (sources/texts/seifert2009.md:21-24) gives 109-125 cm, i.e. six below and ten above the average. "Roughly" carries it; "six to ten centimetres" would be exact.

Cited-but-unbound passages: topic-02.mdx:90-92 (girls begin puberty roughly two years earlier; the ages 10-14 taller-girl crossover) and topic-03.mdx:111-127 (attachment as secure base; preoperational dramatic play including "the banana that is a telephone"; peer-group power peaking in adolescence) sit adjacent to (Seifert & Sutton, 2009) citations but the bound excerpt quotes none of them. All are standard, non-controversial developmental science consistent with the source Chapter 3; bind the passages in sources/texts/seifert2009.md or annotate them as uncorroborated-by-excerpt.
